listitem.para: The left/right participant's public key for EdDSA signature authentication. The argument can be one of the generic arguments listed in leftpubkey/rightpubkey option. The generic DNS-related arguments can use the mechanism described in RFC 9373.
Additionally, one can provide a raw public key generated using ipsec eddsakey command.

caution.para: If two connection descriptions specify different public keys for the same leftid, confusion and madness will ensue.
